_README: HUMAN-CURATED VALUES. NOT FROM THE PATCH DUMPS.
These fill gaps where odota/dotaconstants has no value for a field but the
question is one a player would actually ask. Every tool result built from
this file is tagged source='curated', and the Step 4 system prompt must say
so out loud, because CLAUDE.md section 8 says factual answers come from
tool results reading real data -- and these do not.
Values below were entered by Claude from model memory on 2026-10-26 and are
PENDING HUMAN REVIEW. 'confidence' marks where to look hardest. Several are
genuinely nuanced: spell immunity blocks debuff application but not physical
damage or forced movement, so a bare yes/no is lossy -- hence 'partial'.
Allowed values: yes | no | partial | n/a
Scope: bkbpierce only. dispellable is missing on 333 abilities and dmg_type
on 377 -- far too many to curate without rewriting the dataset from memory.

kunkka_tidebringer.note: Cleave is physical attack damage. Spell immunity does not reduce physical damage.

monkey_king_wukongs_command.note: Soldiers deal physical attack damage, which spell immunity does not block.

mars_gods_rebuke.note: Physical critical strike. The knockback is forced movement, also not blocked.

earthshaker_enchant_totem.note: Bonus damage is applied to Earthshaker's own attack, so it lands as physical damage.

furion_sprout.note: Trees are terrain, not a debuff, so a spell-immune unit is still physically trapped. Any damage component would still be blocked.

hoodwink_bushwhack.note: Stun and damage-over-time are debuffs, blocked by spell immunity.

venomancer_snakebite.note: Magical damage and a toxin debuff; both blocked.

necrolyte_death_pulse.note: Magical damage to enemies. The ally heal is unaffected, being friendly.

abaddon_death_coil.note: Magical damage. Field is an empty list in the dump, not merely absent.

spectre_spectral_dagger.note: Magical damage and movement slow. The Shadow Path itself still appears.

terrorblade_terror_wave.note: Fear is a debuff, so it should be blocked. Newer ability and I am less sure of its current behaviour.

tiny_toss.note: Forced movement is not blocked, so a spell-immune unit can still be grabbed and thrown, but the magical landing damage is blocked. A bare yes/no misrepresents this.

phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.note: Physical damage still lands; the movement slow does not apply. Verify before trusting.

sandking_scorpion_strike.note: Displayed as Stinger. I am unsure of the current damage type and debuff split -- treat as unverified.

antimage_counterspell.note: A self-targeted shell that blocks and reflects incoming targeted spells. 'Does it pierce spell immunity' is not a well-formed question about it.

doom_bringer_devour.note: Targets enemy or neutral creeps only, never heroes, so BKB never applies.
